Log every lead and follow-up in Odoo CRM.

Respond quickly to inbound enquiries.

Join discovery meetings and demos with senior team members.

Help prepare proposals and follow them through to signature and payment.

Represent the company at events and demo sessions in Kochi.

Odoo’s core apps: CRM, Sales, Inventory, Purchase, Accounting, Manufacturing and HR.

How businesses evaluate and buy ERP software.

Prospecting, cold calling, discovery and objection handling.

Managing a sales pipeline from first contact to signed contract.
